title: Frost & Sullivan Names RingCentral a Visionary Leader in 2026 Frost Radar™ for Conversational AI in Patient Engagement
summary: Report cites RingCentral’s agentic voice AI, established communications infrastructure, and deep healthcare expertise BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced it has been named a Visionary Leader by Frost & Sullivan in the Frost Radar™: Conversational AI in Patient Engagement in North America, 2026 . The report highlights how integrated conversational AI can improve patient access, reduce administrative workloads, and enable more seamless coordination between automated workflows and human care teams. RingCentral is recognized for its agentic voice AI platform, established communications infrastructure, and healthcare-specific capabilities as key differentiators. “Healthcare organizations need AI that takes action, automating workflows, assisting care teams in live patient conversations, and analyzing every interaction to make the next one better,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO of RingCentral. “This recognition reflects how our complete customer engagement platform improves patient access, streamlines operations, and delivers better experiences across the patient journey.” The report identifies RingCentral's ability to deliver these AI capabilities through an established communications platform spanning voice, SMS, messaging, video, contact center, digital channels, and APIs. Frost & Sullivan highlights several strengths that differentiate RingCentral's approach to Agentic Voice AI in healthcare, including: One platform from first call to follow-up. RingCentral AI Receptionist™ (AIR), RingCentral AIR Pro™, AI Virtual Assistant (RingCentral AVA™) and AI Conversation Expert (RingCentral ACE™) automate patient interactions, assist care teams with contextual insights, and analyze conversations for quality, compliance, sentiment, and emerging patient needs. Purpose-built healthcare workflows. AIR Pro for Healthcare offers accelerators and best-practice starter kits for identity verification, scheduling, wait-list management, eligibility checks, prescription refills, billing, and digital intake, so organizations can automate without extensive programming. Flexible integration and deployment. With 80 EHR integrations and 600+ integrations across the RingCentral product portfolio, providers can add AI to existing telephony, EHR, and contact center systems without replacing them. Established scale and healthcare expertise. RingCentral supports over 600,000 customers worldwide, including numerous healthcare organizations, such as hospitals, integrated delivery networks, clinics, behavioral health facilities, long-term care providers, and payers. “As conversational AI evolves from individual virtual assistants into an enterprise engagement layer, RingCentral stands out for pairing agentic voice AI with a mature communications foundation,” said Alejandra María Parra, Senior Research Analyst, Healthcare IT, Frost & Sullivan. “This approach enables healthcare organizations to connect automated interactions with human care teams, preserve context across touchpoints, and introduce AI capabilities while continuing to operate existing healthcare systems.” “To deliver on our commitment to easy, modern eye care across our 320+ locations, consistent quality is everything,” said Keyner Bonilla, Telecom Specialist, Now Optics. “RingCentral AI Conversation Expert (ACE) is the primary tool our QA team relies on to analyze interactions between patients and store support. Auditing 90–95% of our 184,000+ monthly calls give us the real-time insights needed to continuously elevate customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.” A benchmarking system that evaluates companies on a Growth Index and an Innovation Index, The Frost Radar™ considers factors including revenue, speed of innovation, platform breadth, funding activity, and new partnership and customer announcements. Out of 100 qualified participants in the Frost Radar, only 13 were selected as leaders. RingCentral earned an Innovation Score of 3.80 and a Growth Score of 3.95 out of 4. Frost & Sullivan also notes RingCentral's over $250 million in annual R&D investment, with majority allocated to new products and initiatives, including agentic voice AI and healthcare capabilities. To view the report, please visit: https://assets.ringcentral.com/us/report/frost-radar-conversational-ai-in-patient-engagement-in-na-2026-ringcentral.pdf About RingCentral RingCentral is a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. Powered by advanced AI capabilities, RingCentral delivers intelligence at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each human interaction. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more. ©2026 RingCentral, Inc. All rights reserved. *Report cites RingCentral’s agentic voice AI, established communications infrastructure, and deep healthcare expertise*


BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[RingCentral, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2F&esheet=54644902&newsitemid=20261123753601&lan=en-US&anchor=RingCentral%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=6732e1258d48b5db0755593e61d23f93) . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced it has been named a Visionary Leader by Frost & Sullivan in the[Frost Radar™: Conversational AI in Patient Engagement in North America, 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.ringcentral.com%2Fus%2Freport%2Ffrost-radar-conversational-ai-in-patient-engagement-in-na-2026-ringcentral.pdf&esheet=54644902&newsitemid=20261123753601&lan=en-US&anchor=Frost+Radar%E2%84%A2%3A+Conversational+AI+in+Patient+Engagement+in+North+America%2C+2026&index=2&md5=8d2622fcf0054d872b4e9d65f5e60978) . The report highlights how integrated conversational AI can improve patient access, reduce administrative workloads, and enable more seamless coordination between automated workflows and human care teams. RingCentral is recognized for its agentic voice AI platform, established communications infrastructure, and healthcare-specific capabilities as key differentiators.


“Healthcare organizations need AI that takes action, automating workflows, assisting care teams in live patient conversations, and analyzing every interaction to make the next one better,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO of RingCentral. “This recognition reflects how our complete customer engagement platform improves patient access, streamlines operations, and delivers better experiences across the patient journey.”


The report identifies RingCentral's ability to deliver these AI capabilities through an established communications platform spanning voice, SMS, messaging, video, contact center, digital channels, and APIs. Frost & Sullivan highlights several strengths that differentiate RingCentral's approach to Agentic Voice AI in healthcare, including:


- **One platform from first call to follow-up.** RingCentral AI Receptionist™ (AIR), RingCentral AIR Pro™, AI Virtual Assistant (RingCentral AVA™) and AI Conversation Expert (RingCentral ACE™) automate patient interactions, assist care teams with contextual insights, and analyze conversations for quality, compliance, sentiment, and emerging patient needs.
- **Purpose-built healthcare workflows.** AIR Pro for Healthcare offers accelerators and best-practice starter kits for identity verification, scheduling, wait-list management, eligibility checks, prescription refills, billing, and digital intake, so organizations can automate without extensive programming.
- **Flexible integration and deployment.** With 80 EHR integrations and 600+ integrations across the RingCentral product portfolio, providers can add AI to existing telephony, EHR, and contact center systems without replacing them.
- **Established scale and healthcare expertise.** RingCentral supports over 600,000 customers worldwide, including numerous healthcare organizations, such as hospitals, integrated delivery networks, clinics, behavioral health facilities, long-term care providers, and payers.


“As conversational AI evolves from individual virtual assistants into an enterprise engagement layer, RingCentral stands out for pairing agentic voice AI with a mature communications foundation,” said Alejandra María Parra, Senior Research Analyst, Healthcare IT, Frost & Sullivan. “This approach enables healthcare organizations to connect automated interactions with human care teams, preserve context across touchpoints, and introduce AI capabilities while continuing to operate existing healthcare systems.”


“To deliver on our commitment to easy, modern eye care across our 320+ locations, consistent quality is everything,” said Keyner Bonilla, Telecom Specialist, Now Optics. “RingCentral AI Conversation Expert (ACE) is the primary tool our QA team relies on to analyze interactions between patients and store support. Auditing 90–95% of our 184,000+ monthly calls give us the real-time insights needed to continuously elevate customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.”


A benchmarking system that evaluates companies on a Growth Index and an Innovation Index, The Frost Radar™ considers factors including revenue, speed of innovation, platform breadth, funding activity, and new partnership and customer announcements. Out of 100 qualified participants in the Frost Radar, only 13 were selected as leaders. RingCentral earned an Innovation Score of 3.80 and a Growth Score of 3.95 out of 4.


Frost & Sullivan also notes RingCentral's over $250 million in annual R&D investment, with majority allocated to new products and initiatives, including agentic voice AI and healthcare capabilities.
